text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Spurred on by the support of her fans,<n>Rice Shower
wins the Takarazuka<n>Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Having made so many people smile,<n>she finally
becomes the blue rose she<n>always aspired to be.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With the Takarazuka Kinen behind<n>her, she decides
to run in the Arima<n>Kinen against Mihono Bourbon
and<n>Mejiro McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Like the Takarazuka Kinen, only<n>racers selected by
the fans can run in<n>the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her state her intention to run in<n>such a
prestigious race without a hint<n>of apprehension, I
can sense how<n>much Rice Shower has grown.
